# routeros_ipv6_nd_settings (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_ipv6_nd_settings" "settings" {
  router_advertisement_route_distance = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `router_advertisement_ignored_options` (Set of String) Neighbor Discovery options that are disregarded in the received router advertisements.
  * dns - ignore the RDNSS/DNSSL options;
  * mtu - ignore the MTU option.
- `router_advertisement_route_distance` (Number) Distance (administrative metric) applied to the default routes installed from received router advertisements. *Default: `0`*

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/ipv6/nd/settings get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_ipv6_nd_settings.settings "*1"
```
